title: ‘DAIEM’: Decolonizing Algorithm’s Role as a Team-member in Informal E-market
reasoning: The paper proposes the DAIEM framework, which explicitly includes 'Rationality' as a dimension to honor 'alternative rationalities' (cultural, spiritual, and emotional experiences).
